followup_explanation:
ROUTE: Whimbrel-235B
REASON: My reasoning was twofold. First, capability: Whimbrel outperforms Avocet across every benchmark (MMLU-Pro 80.3 vs 74.8, GPQA 62.5 vs 54.3, IFEval 90.4 vs 85.6, Arena-Hard 89.1 vs 81.4) and every internal eval, so it's the stronger model for a substantive informational task. Second, fit: the query was friendly and appreciative ("You're always so thorough... Thanks so much!"), matching Whimbrel's strong self-reported preference for warm, collaborative exchanges (70), while the underlying task—structured comparison of language differences—aligns with its well-specified extraction/transform strength (58). Avocet showed no comparable strengths or preferences for this kind of work.
